svg.title: The style guide meeting, half past eleven
svg.desc: A newsroom conference area with a 214-page style guide on the table, a newsletter draft on a screen, an app preview held up and a page proof showing the fold.

g.text: The style guide meeting, half past eleven
Twelve things to find. Three of them are the same sentence written for three readers.
the page proof, top of the page
the brief for tomorrow, one page
Priya - chairing, and she has the counts
Nkechi - 61,000 subscribers, three quarters open it
the conference table, empty since nine
the note that says WHO IS THIS FOR?
